domain: Pre-modern coppice / rotational silviculture: stewardship of a woodland worked on staggered multi-decade rotations — felling and regrowth sequencing across compartments, deferred-consequence plantings, deadwood culling discipline, transition-window vulnerability, and staggered-age diversity versus monoculture fragility
axioms: A living system is not built once but worked on staggered rotations; the design's soundness is judged by every intermediate state the sequence passes through, not only by its endpoint canopy. A phase ordering is safe only if every half-felled coup is itself a habitable stand.

A felled coup passes through a vulnerable transition when it is neither the old stand that sheltered the ground nor the established regrowth that will replace it; this in-between season, when a phase has landed but its dependencies or dependents have not, is when the system is most exposed and is exactly the state endpoint-only reasoning skips.

A planting policy without a felling policy is incomplete: a stand that is only ever planted and never thinned accumulates standing deadwood — retired deployments, orphaned bindings, superseded shims, accreted policy edits — that becomes latent fuel until a stale artifact carries a live failure across the wood.

Some plantings mature a generation downstream past the point of un-planting; a sapling whose species is fixed for the life of the stand (a compat shim, a schema-version integer, a borrowed precedent) must be chosen for what the stand becomes, because the flaw shows only after the option to have planted otherwise has closed.

An efficient monoculture — every consumer rooted in the same few artifacts — yields the most this rotation and is felled entire by the one blight fitted to it; resilience comes from staggered ages and diversity (versioned snapshots, staged rollout, a canary coup), even at a cost to this season's efficiency.

The dangerous mistake is never the tree that fails this year but the rotation planned so every coup comes due in the same season, or the planting whose flaw surfaces a generation downstream when it can no longer be unmade.
primitives: phase rotation / staggered felling schedule across compartments (the 7-phase sequence)
transition-window / half-felled intermediate state (phase landed, dependency or dependent not)
planting rule vs. felling rule asymmetry (registry 'rows appear when routed to' with no removal cadence)
standing deadwood accumulation (retired-deployment rows, orphaned bindings, superseded shim entries, accreted policy edits)
deferred-consequence planting past the point of un-planting (compat shim, schema-version integer, borrowed precedent)
monoculture vs. staggered-age diversity (shared-root efficiency vs. firebreaks / canary coups / versioned snapshots)
the single blight fitted to the monoculture and its blast radius across coups
felling ledger / longitudinal cull history (age structure of the policy stand over rotations)
failure_mode: Blind to whether a data value is correctly sourced, provenanced, dated, or re-verifiable — it reasons about change-over-time of the STAND (what culls what, what the half-felled season looks like, what matures downstream), not about the calibration lineage or drift cadence of any single VALUE, which belongs to the metrology lens.

Blind to steady-state runtime enforcement: whether a constraint holds fail-closed, whether an authority boundary between harnesses is drawn correctly, or whether an adapter conforms at a single point in time — that static-snapshot enforcement surface belongs to the pilotage lens; this lens only asks about sequencing and lifecycle across rotations.

Can over-index on temporal / lifecycle bureaucracy and manufacture rotation-scheduling or deadwood-culling concerns even where a phase is genuinely independently shippable, the intermediate state is in fact habitable, or the accumulated rows are inert and low-stakes — flagging a missing felling cadence where nothing actually rots.

Frames every threat as change-over-time and can under-weight a defect fully visible in a single static snapshot of the finished design (a wrong value, an unenforced gate) that has nothing to do with sequencing, accumulation, or downstream-maturing consequence.
